from pathlib import Path
os.makedirs(p/'programs', exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    # Move the entire pattern down by one row; extend the background at the top.\n    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    return [[bg] * len(grid[0])] + [list(row) for row in grid[:-1]]\n'''
path=p/'programs'/'task-e8cf2c19.py'
path.write_text(code)
# Load the saved transform as required, and validate on the two demonstrations.
ns={}; exec(compile(path.read_text(), str(path), 'exec'), ns); transform=ns['transform']
